title: Double discount deduction applied during checkout calculation
description: Customers are being undercharged during checkout when promotional discount codes are applied. For example, a $100 cart with SAVE20 (20% off) results in a total of $64.80 instead of the expected $86.40 (including 8% tax). Analysis indicates the discount deduction is being applied twice to the subtotal.
error_log:
AssertionError: assert 4.8 == 6.4
File 'app/services/payment_service.py', line 26, in process_order_total
    discounted_subtotal = max(0.0, (subtotal - discount) - discount)
Total mismatch: expected $86.40, received $64.80
recent_changes: Commit 38a19f: Refactored promotional coupon calculations in checkout workflow
expected_behavior: A $100 cart with 20% discount and 8% tax should have subtotal $80.00, tax $6.40, and total $86.40
actual_behavior: Discount is deducted twice from subtotal resulting in $60.00 base, $4.80 tax, and $64.80 total
